data.narrative:
Aurelius Systems is a seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables in Defense & Security, alongside 2 public market comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and additional private benchmarks including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $10M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a typical 2.5x seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a valuation of $25M. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company comparable set—which ranges from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A)—yields a median valuation of $700M. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage, maturity, and market positioning within the defense tech sector.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a valuation range of $21M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $362M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects fundamental uncertainty about Aurelius's relative competitive position and growth trajectory within a sector where comparable valuations span nearly two orders of magnitude. Key sensitivities include the applicability of Series A comparables to a seed-stage business and the degree to which Aurelius's technology and market access align with higher-valued peers.
